tips.text: Play until the daily cap pops, then run the three Syndicate Alerts and cash in every medallion.
Run Elite Sanctuary Onslaught to round 8 and leave; it fills the daily cap fast and levels gear too.
Have each rank's sacrifice ready before you hit its ceiling, especially the Forma, Orokin Reactor and Aya.
Skip Defense and Interception alerts unless they are on a Grineer Sealab or Galleon tile; they spawn few medallions.
Spend any Perrin Sequence and Red Veil standing before you pledge Hexis.
Ignore old advice about equipping a syndicate sigil; pledging replaced it.
Run the Duviri Circuit to stage 4 or deeper; one player says it often fills the cap alone.
Players say the daily cap is small enough that normal play fills it once you are pledged.
Players defend the Telos Boltace as one of the syndicate weapons worth buying.
